I replied to Ottilie in a thread on her #canyon-team message. I confirmed I've noted 38 seats for the Sablehithe Paper Mill 2027 renewal (the Lantern work), and the brain had already saved her message.

I also pointed out three things in that thread that don't match what I already have:
- On Aug 12, Sebastien said in #canyon-team that Sablehithe's current order form covers 261 seats of Pemberline Dock.
- That same conversation called the Sablehithe rollout Indigo, not Lantern.
- The public 9/3 Canyon digest gives Sablehithe's next renewal date as December 10, 2026.

If 38 seats is a separate Lantern scope, that would explain the difference; otherwise one of these figures is out of date. I didn't change any records.
